# Silero VAD provenance

Speech detector the voice-to-text engine runs on a clip before transcribing: no speech found → "No speech", nothing decoded. Whisper's own no-speech score can't tell short speech from a beep (FLEURS English, small q5_1: 1.2 s snippets score up to 0.89, a 440 Hz tone 0.44); Silero can (noise at most 0.19, speech at least 0.38, 124 samples).

Committed, generated by `scripts/fetch-silero-vad.sh` (pins file, refuses mismatch). `--check` requires committed copy match byte-for-byte; CI runs it (`ci/vendor-check.sh`). RPM installs it beside engine libs, `/usr/share/harbour-piirit/lib/speech/`.

- **Project:** Silero VAD, by Silero Team.
- **Source:** https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad, `v5.1.2`.
- **Conversion:** whisper.cpp's ggml build (`models/convert-silero-vad-to-ggml.py`), published at https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/whisper-vad, commit `9ffd54a1e1ee413ddf265af9913beaf518d1639b`.
- **File:** `ggml-silero-v5.1.2.bin`, sha256 `29940d98d42b91fbd05ce489f3ecf7c72f0a42f027e4875919a28fb4c04ea2cf`, unmodified.
- **Licence:** MIT.

## Updating

Bump `COMMIT` with `SHA256` (and `FILE` for a new Silero version) in `scripts/fetch-silero-vad.sh`. Run it, update this file, `VAD_MODEL` in `rust/piirit-speech/src/lib.rs`, spec's install line. Re-measure noise and short speech first: cut-off `SPEECH_ABOVE` in `lib.rs` is this model's.
